title: Import-reconciliation activation and adoption: require the live state's exact known metadata generation, not only refuse a newer one
outcome: The activation commits only on top of the metadata generation the live state knows (exact predecessor), or adoption accepts only committed_generation == known + 1 (or == known for an idempotent re-adopt), so adoption can never move metadata_predecessor past durable content the live state never adopted.
acceptance: Import-reconciliation activation and adoption: require the live state's exact known metadata generation, not only refuse a newer one is done
